tvShow.name: Outlander: Blood of My Blood
tvShow.overview: From the battlefields of World War I to the rugged Highlands of 18th century Scotland, two fated couples must defy the forces that seek to tear them apart, unfolding in surprising and unforeseen ways in this romantic saga that unfolds across time.

episodes.name: Outlander & Blood of My Blood: The Gathering
episodes.overview: Outlander and Blood of My Blood: The Gathering unites cast members from both series for the first time to celebrate the Outlander journey, welcome in the new generation of Frasers, MacKenzies and Beauchamps, and explore the ties that bind their stories.

episodes.name: Providence
episodes.overview: At the Gathering, Brian Fraser and Ellen MacKenzie meet for the first time and are struck by their strong connection.

episodes.name: S.W.A.K. (Sealed with a Kiss)
episodes.overview: While Henry fights in WWI and Julia works in the censorship office in London, their love story unfolds through the letters they write to each other.

episodes.name: School of the Moon
episodes.overview: Ellen hatches a new plan to protect herself and her family. Julia is forced to make an impossible choice.

episodes.name: A Soldier's Heart
episodes.overview: Henry tackles a challenging assignment in his own way. Ellen learns some concerning information about the family into which she’s expected to marry.

episodes.name: Needfire
episodes.overview: Ellen and Brian attend Beltane. Henry struggles to hold onto his hope. Julia loses allies when secrets come out.

episodes.name: Birthright
episodes.overview: Henry continues to look for Julia until a new discovery threatens to end his search.

episodes.name: Luceo Non Uro
episodes.overview: Lord Lovat goes to extreme lengths to fulfill a prophecy. Dougal attends a clandestine meeting that could spell political disaster for the MacKenzies.

episodes.name: A Virtuous Woman
episodes.overview: At the request of the Grants, Ellen undergoes a test to prove her worthiness to marry into the clan.

episodes.name: Braemar
episodes.overview: All the highland clans attend the Earl of Mar's annual hunting event at Braemar Castle, where the Earl makes an inflammatory proclamation.

episodes.name: Something Borrowed
episodes.overview: Ellen prepares for her wedding day, while Julia attempts her escape.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In the second season, our lovers are separated once again as the Scottish Highlands are split in two by the 1715 Jacobite Rising, thrusting the clans into war and forcing them to choose a side in the rebellion.

videos.name: 'A Once In a Lifetime Opportunity' Clip
